screen.title: Conversation: At the bus stop
screen.prompt: Listen to a conversation between two people.

audio.text: Excuse me, is this the line for the bus to the airport?
It is, but the next bus isn't until two thirty. The one thirty bus was cancelled.
Oh no. My flight leaves at four.
You could take a taxi from the stand around the corner. It's faster, but it costs more.
I think I'll do that. I can't miss my flight.

options: Her bus was cancelled and she might be late.
She is waiting in the wrong line.
Her flight was cancelled because of the weather.

why.en: The problem. D moves the bus cancellation to a flight.
why.tr: Sorun. D otobüs iptalini uçağa taşıyor.
why.es: El problema. D traslada la cancelación del autobús a un vuelo.

questions.stem: What will the woman probably do?
options: Change her flight to a later time
Wait for the two thirty bus
Take a taxi to the airport
